item.title:
“We show solidarity with suicide bombers.”
Monica Moorehead, a retired teacher and outspoken anti-Israel activist is seen on camera expressing support for suicide bombers.
She also argues that Abbas al-Sayed, a senior Hamas figure who orchestrated the 2002 Passover massacre at the Park Hotel in Netanya, killing 30 people and injuring 140, should be released, claiming that “any resistance carried out by Palestinians is justified.”
